_why: The L0 slot registry (EPL-A2): slot SHAPES are declared by their owning module;
MEMBERS are authored per reality by the pool loop. This file is the single source
both the Rust engine and the Python loop read, so they cannot disagree.
HAND-WRITTEN TODAY, GENERATED LATER. doc 40.12 §7 puts the declaration in Rust
(`declare_pool_slot!` in crates/ruleset-core/src/pool/) with this file as its build
output plus a drift test. Until that lands this file is authored directly, and a
`"generated": false` flag says so rather than letting a reader assume otherwise.

_axes.shape: what the output looks like — MOD-A1
_axes.operation: what the planner does to its evidence — BLD-A1. Yields the criteria.
_axes.visibility: SHARED = other modules may reference its members; PRIVATE = owner only (EPL-A7)
_axes.default: CONFIRM slots only, and REQUIRED for them: the declared set a reality keeps or overrides. A CONFIRM slot with no default has nothing to confirm, and the loader refuses to load one.

slots._axis_note: BLD-A2: the axis is computed from `consumed_by` — these consumers condition rules on the tag, so the abstraction is by what a practitioner trains with, not by how an object looks.

slots._lex_tags_note: MEM-A4's gap, finally written as a REFERENCE instead of prose. It was recorded as 'the one real gap in the item contract' and then existed nowhere the machinery could see — so the register reported no demand for it, and the item generator's field census had to special-case it. A gap named only in a document is a gap two mechanisms disagree about. WA_001 owns lex_tag; an archetype declares which lexical tags things of its kind carry (PL_007 §12.7, the WA_001 Stage-4 input).
slots._gates_on_note: MEM-A4 open #2 — kept OPTIONAL on purpose. It is the first OUTBOUND reference from item into progression, so it is where EPL-A8 fires in that direction. progression_kind was unregistered for one cycle; PROG_001 has now registered it below, and the row it used to raise is gone. equip_slot still dangles, so the demand channel is still under load.

slots._visibility_note: Registered PRIVATE first, and the LOADER refused it. The reasoning for PRIVATE was sound on its own — the only reference is item's own item_archetype.equip_slot, so SHARED would claim something nothing supports. What it missed is that item_archetype is itself SHARED, so its member bodies carry `"equip_slot": "main_hand"` into loot and crafting whatever this field says. Withholding the slot's MEMBERS does not withhold the codes; redacting the field from the bodies would be worse, because an absent optional field is indistinguishable from 'this archetype has no equip slot'. Visibility may not decrease along a reference (enforced in load_registry), and the consequence is a real constraint: a slot any SHARED slot points at cannot be private, whatever its owner intended.
slots._default_note: A body plan, not a genre choice — the same six read sensibly for a wuxia sect disciple and a mail-clad knight. A reality that runs a different anatomy DROPS what it does not have and says why, which is what CONFIRM is for.

This default is the CULTIVATION profile's, not a universal one — PPO-A4 says closure is profile-relative. A different profile ships a different default, and that is precisely what a CONFIRM slot is for: the platform declares, the reality keeps or overrides with evidence. `standing` is the social/reputation track; it is here because doc 05's general-RPG delta counts it as progression, and a wuxia reality that has no such track is expected to DROP it and say why.

slots._ordinal_note: QTY-A5 — no member carries an ordinal out of the model. The model returns an ORDER (list position); the PLANNER stamps 1..N per kind, and only once the set has SETTLED, because you cannot number a ladder that is still changing. A member that arrives WITH an ordinal is a hard criterion failure, not a value to trust.

_not_registered_yet.lex_tag: WA_001 must register it — the MEM-A4 gap, and the LAST subject the EPL-A8 demand channel has. equip_slot used to be the other one and is registered above; if this one closes too, the channel has nothing left to demonstrate on and a test that asserts a non-empty demand set will red. That red is correct: it means the check needs a new subject or should be retired, and neither should happen silently.
